title: Resolution urging Albany to regulate crypto ATMs against fraud
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature to pass, and the Governor to sign, S.9891-B/A.10899-C, which would regulate cryptocurrency kiosks statewide. The bill would require kiosks to display warnings against scams, verify wallet ownership and let fraud victims seek reimbursement. New York State recorded 318 cryptocurrency kiosk fraud complaints totaling $5,777,640 in losses, with older adults disproportionately affected.
